source: NCCN Management of Immunotherapy-Related Toxicities v1.2024; Schneider BJ et al. JCO 2021 (ASCO Guideline Update)
citation_primary: Schneider BJ, Naidoo J, Santomasso BD, et al. Management of Immune-Related Adverse Events in Patients Treated With Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy: ASCO Guideline Update. J Clin Oncol. 2021;39(36):4073-4126.
citation_nccn: NCCN Clinical Practice Guidelines in Oncology: Management of Immunotherapy-Related Toxicities. Version 1.2024.

colitis.incidence: Up to 30% with combination ICI; 10-15% with single agent

grade_1.criteria: <4 stools/day above baseline; asymptomatic; no blood

grade_2.criteria: 4-6 stools/day above baseline; abdominal pain; mucus/blood

grade_3.criteria: ≥7 stools/day; severe abdominal pain; peritoneal signs; IV steroids

management.grade_1: Hold ICI if worsening. Loperamide, budesonide. Monitor closely.
management.grade_2: Hold ICI. Stool cultures (C. diff, CMV, bacterial). Colonoscopy if persistent. Prednisone 1mg/kg/day.
management.grade_3-4: Permanently discontinue ICI. IV methylprednisolone 1-2mg/kg/day. GI consult. Infliximab if steroid-refractory.

triage_rules.reasoning: Grade 4 irAE colitis — life-threatening. Permanently discontinue ICI. IV steroids + GI emergency evaluation.
Grade ≥2 diarrhea with immunotherapy — immune-mediated colitis must be ruled out. Hold ICI. Stool workup + steroids per NCCN/ASCO irAE guidelines.

pneumonitis.incidence: 2-4% PD-1/PD-L1 monotherapy; up to 10% with combination

grade_2.criteria: Symptomatic; new dyspnea; limiting instrumental ADL

grade_3.criteria: Severe dyspnea; limiting self-care ADL; supplemental O2 required

management.grade_1: Hold ICI. CT chest + PFTs. Pulmonology consult. Restart only if grade 1 resolves.
management.grade_2: Hold ICI. Prednisone 1mg/kg/day. CT chest. Bronchoscopy if workup unclear.
management.grade_3-4: Permanently discontinue ICI. IV methylprednisolone 1-2mg/kg/day. ICU consideration. Infliximab/MMF if steroid-refractory.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (dyspnea == true OR new_cough == true)
triage_rules.reasoning: Any new respiratory symptom with immunotherapy — irAE pneumonitis until proven otherwise. CT chest required. Hold ICI pending evaluation per NCCN/ASCO irAE guidelines.
Grade ≥3 pneumonitis — immediately life-threatening. IV steroids, emergency pulmonology.
Jaundice with immunotherapy — irAE hepatitis with possible liver failure. Emergency hepatology evaluation. LFTs, coagulation studies urgently needed.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (ruq_pain == true OR dark_urine == true)
triage_rules.reasoning: RUQ pain or dark urine with immunotherapy — possible irAE hepatitis. Same-day LFT assessment required.

hypophysitis.incidence: Up to 10% with CTLA-4; <1% with PD-1/PD-L1

grade_1.criteria: Asymptomatic or mild; no hormone deficiency detected

grade_3.criteria: Severe symptoms; hospitalization indicated; adrenal crisis risk

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (hypotension == true OR confusion == true) AND fatigue_severe == true
triage_rules.reasoning: Possible irAE hypophysitis with adrenal crisis — hypotension, confusion, severe fatigue. Urgent IV hydrocortisone + imaging. ACTH stimulation test.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND severe_headache == true AND fatigue_severe == true
triage_rules.reasoning: Headache + severe fatigue with immunotherapy — irAE hypophysitis pattern. MRI pituitary + cortisol/ACTH panel required. Per ASCO/NCCN irAE guidelines.

myocarditis.incidence: <1% but case fatality rate up to 25-50%

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (chest_pain == true OR palpitations == true)
triage_rules.reasoning: Chest pain or palpitations with immunotherapy — irAE myocarditis is rare but has up to 50% case fatality rate. Immediately discontinue ICI. Emergency ECG, troponin, echo. Cardiology consultation STAT.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND palpitations == true AND tremor == true AND heat_intolerance == true
triage_rules.reasoning: Possible thyroid storm pattern with immunotherapy. Emergency evaluation — TFTs, cardiology.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (palpitations == true OR unexpected_weight_loss == true OR tremor == true)
triage_rules.reasoning: Possible irAE thyroid dysfunction. Routine TFT panel (TSH, free T4) within 24-48h. Continue ICI if clinically stable.

triage_rules.condition: recent_immunotherapy == true AND (decreased_urine_output == true OR edema == true OR hematuria == true)
triage_rules.reasoning: Possible irAE nephritis with immunotherapy. Same-day BMP/creatinine/urinalysis. Hold ICI pending evaluation per NCCN/ASCO guidelines.

irae_dermatitis.incidence: Most common irAE — up to 40% of patients

triage_rules.reasoning: Grade ≥3 immune-mediated dermatitis — Stevens-Johnson syndrome or TEN must be excluded. Hold ICI immediately. Emergency dermatology.
Grade 2 immune-mediated dermatitis. Hold ICI if progressing. Topical or systemic steroids per NCCN irAE guidelines.
